from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path
import re
from datetime import datetime
import calendar

input_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/51958/1_51958_input.xlsx'
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/51958_0_5a56d13c/1_51958_output.xlsx'

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb.active

value = ws['A2'].value

def convert_last_online(v):
    if v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        # If already a datetime, normalize year to 2021 only if it is missing/implied is not applicable.
        return v
    text = str(v).strip()
    # Expected pattern like: "9th Aug 10:08" (also accepts 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 11th, etc.)
    m = re.match(r'^\s*(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*$', text)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized date/time format in A2: {v!r}")
    day = int(m.group(1))
    mon_text = m.group(2).lower()
    hour = int(m.group(3))
    minute = int(m.group(4))
    second = int(m.group(5) or 0)
    months = {name.lower(): i for i, name in enumerate(calendar.month_abbr) if name}
    months.update({name.lower(): i for i, name in enumerate(calendar.month_name) if name})
    # also allow first three letters of full names
    months.update({name[:3].lower(): i for i, name in enumerate(calendar.month_name) if name})
    month = months[mon_text[:3] if mon_text[:3] in months else mon_text]
    return datetime(2021, month, day, hour, minute, second)

dt = convert_last_online(value)
ws['B2'] = dt
ws['B2'].number_format = 'dd/mm/yy hh:mm'

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Saved {output_path}; B2={ws['B2'].value!r}, number_format={ws['B2'].number_format}")
